messages:
jamie: Quick heads-up — during a KB sweep I found a couple of orphan anchors and one image 404 in /kb/runtime/optimizations. Looks like frontmatter changed and left old anchors. Can someone claim ownership? I can open a tiny PR but want owner to approve.

kb-bot: scan-report: 3 broken anchors found in /kb/runtime/optimizations and 1 missing image at /assets/optim-cache.png

alex: thanks jamie — can you paste the exact doc paths?

jamie: sure — /kb/runtime/optimizations/index.md#kv-cache-ttl and /kb/runtime/optimizations/index.md#batching-tips and one anchor in /kb/runtime/optimizations/advanced.md#kernel-selection

priya: I can do a quick PR for the anchors. For the image, do we want to rehost to the CDN or replace with a placeholder?

jamie: rehost to CDN is preferred; original file is in s3://redwood-docs-assets/optim-cache.png

morgan: pinging policy — if it's an image from external we need lic check; if it's our asset rehost to CDN + update path is fine. Also add a changelog note.

priya: ok I'll open PR with sed replace and upload to CDN. sed I'm planning: 
```bash
rg "#kv-cache-ttl" -n || true
git checkout -b docs/anchors-fix
sed -i 's/#kv-cache-ttl/#kv-cache-ttl-compat/' kb/runtime/optimizations/index.md
```
I'll include a note in the PR description linking this thread.

alex: FYI, add @jamie for review and include the eval test that checks anchors rendering in staging. There's a small test harness at /devops/docs-checker.

jamie: perfect — if priya posts the PR number I'll do quick review and approve. :thumbsup: 

kb-bot: deploy-preview created: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr/4321 — link-checker started

priya: PR opened: #4321 — small sed, rehost image to CDN at /images/optim-cache.png, added changelog line. @jamie please review when you have a sec.

jamie: reviewing now. Minor nit on alt text. back in 10.

morgan: adding to release notes draft under Docs fixes.

jamie: approved and merged. :tada: Thanks all. Closing thread.
